evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-13"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-13", a date only. POST with no dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/2 {"dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 200 and the new date. PATCH /todos/1 {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null, and a later GET /todos confirmed it.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30" returned 400. POST with "14.10.2026" returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Test data on 2026-10-14 UTC: todo 2 (due 2026-10-01, open), todo 3 (due today), todo 4 (no due date), todo 5 (due 2026-01-01, marked done), todo 1 (due date removed). GET /todos?filter=overdue returned only todo 2. Todos due today, without a due date, or done were excluded.
evidence.AC5: The list page at / showed 'fällig 01.10.2026', 'fällig 14.10.2026' and 'fällig 01.01.2026' next to the todos that have a due date. The todos without a due date showed none.
evidence.AC6: On the page only 'future' (due 01.10.2026, open) carried 'überfällig'. The todo due today, the one with no date, and the done one with a past date (pastdone) had no such label.
evidence.AC7: The checkbox 'nur überfällige' is on the page. Clicking it reduced the list to the single overdue item, 'future – fällig 01.10.2026 überfällig'.
